entities.summary: Abolition and Full Emancipation, a transformative movement in Antigua and Barbuda (1807–1838). Emerged from Abolition of the slave trade in 1807 and the Emancipation Act and Abolition of the slave trade 1807. Catalyzed Full emancipation granted August 1, 1834 — no apprenticeship period and Free Labor Economy and Continued Planter Dominance.
